description: This file defines the main React component 'App' for a web application. It manages theme switching between light and dark modes, sets up routing using react-router-dom, and includes navigation to a SignIn component. The file imports React hooks, routing components, styling, and a SignIn11235 component, and renders routing logic for the homepage and sign-in page.
